scope: Current workspace build. Single-file uses its produced Brotli sidecar; split mode Brotli-compresses each JS module and CSS at the local server, while WASM is served raw. Seven cold trials per entry and format, each in a fresh browser context. First preview timing ends at onRendered and includes first-time format worker setup. Startup byte totals include only resources requested through the selected preview; module request counts exclude the HTML page.
